GoalOptions.Label: Validate Cloud Strategy
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to validate the proposed cloud provider selection framework, ensuring it aligns with enterprise strategic objectives and provides a defensible, auditable decision process for the Board. Success means securing executive buy-in for the framework's implementation.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize TCO & ROI
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to demonstrate how the event-driven cloud selection framework optimizes Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and maximizes Return on Investment (ROI) for our cloud migration. Success is achieved when the Board and VP Engineering understand the financial benefits and approve resource allocation based on this analysis.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Compliance & Security
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to assure stakeholders that the cloud provider evaluation framework rigorously addresses security, compliance, and governance requirements. Success means demonstrating that the chosen provider will meet all regulatory standards and mitigate critical risks, satisfying the Board and VP Engineering.

GoalOptions.Label: Enable Future Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: This document seeks to illustrate how the selected cloud provider, through our evaluation framework, will best support future innovation in AI/ML and advanced analytics. Success is defined by gaining approval to proceed with a provider that strategically positions the company for technological leadership and agility.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Financial Focus
Criteria: Pass/Fail: Adherence to enterprise budget constraints for cloud spend.
Demonstrated TCO advantage over a 5-year horizon.
Flexible pricing models and commitment discounts.
Clear exit strategy and data portability costs.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Operational Focus
Criteria: Pass/Fail: Native support for event-driven architectures and serverless computing.
Robust integration capabilities with existing enterprise systems.
Scalability and reliability metrics meeting 99.99% uptime targets.
Maturity of AI/ML and data analytics services.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Security & Compliance Focus
Criteria: Pass/Fail: Certification against industry-specific compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2).
Granular identity and access management (IAM) controls.
Comprehensive audit logging and monitoring features.
